patches.title: Examine Open Surfaces Only
patches.principle: Do not use examine on closed containers; use open to reveal contents. Examine only on open surfaces.
patches.when_to_apply: When you need to check a container's contents.

patches.title: Begin Search on Countertops
patches.principle: Start your search on countertops and other open surfaces before opening containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When starting a new task and objects may be on surfaces.

patches.title: Exhaust Cabinets Before Drawers
patches.principle: Open all cabinets of the same type before switching to drawers or other containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and cabinets remain unopened.
